notes: Pre-registered plan committed first (claim PR). H1 (analytic = central FD to 1e-4 scaled) held: 2.3e-6 on 32/34, 1.26e-3 on case118 TYP/SAD falling to 1.26e-5 with a 10x smaller step (FD truncation). H2 held: J-m-a fully clean 19/34 (FD 18), 29/34 with reactive stage (FD 28). H3 refuted: finished-repair cost differs >0.05 pp on 6/17, worst 3.08 pp (case14 SAD), because the method stops at the first clean round. H4 refuted: 1.1x faster (1491 s -> 1353 s), PIPS QP 98-99 % of repair time (profile_vlin.py on case118 API, case240 SAD, case73 SAD).
